healingSeed.desc: Plants a seed beside an ally: allies within 1 tile heal every turn for 3 rounds, then it sprouts into a tree.

poisonSeed.desc: Plants a seed: enemies within 1 tile are Poisoned every turn for 3 rounds, then it sprouts into a tree.

leechSeed.desc: Plants a seed on a Single Enemy: for 3 rounds it drains HP from the target each turn and heals the caster.

racePlasmaWhip.desc: The whip cracks down the lane. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a line up to 3 tiles long and sets them alight. It reaches further than it should and burns where it lands.

raceAncientMagic.desc: Words older than the pyramids. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and Silences them for a round.

raceApexCharge.desc: Stampedes through the battlefield and ends up behind the target. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to the target and tramples every enemy on the path. Applies Stagger.

raceWebLaunch.desc: A thread of void-silk. Deals WEAK arcane damage to a Single Enemy and Roots them for a round.

raceDimensionalWeb.desc: Weave a web between dimensions over a 3×3 for 2 rounds. Enemies standing in it are Rooted. Whatever stands in it cannot leave.

racePolymorph.desc: Something small and harmless. Ribbit. The target is Silenced for 2 rounds and its ATK drops by 1 stage.

raceWishGranted.desc: Your wish is granted. Raises a Single Ally's ATK and M ATK by 1 stage and cleanses 2 debuffs.

raceBombArrow.desc: An arrow with a powder charge lashed to the head. Deals WEAK physical damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and sets them alight for a round.

raceArrowRain.desc: Loose high and let gravity do the rest. HEAVY physical damage to every enemy in a 3×3 up to 6 tiles away. The arrows come down over any wall.

raceOvercalculate.desc: Run the numbers again. Then again. Raises the caster's M ATK and M DEF by 1 stage.

raceRecursiveLoop.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Marked targets.

rampage.desc: Charges through the battlefield. Deals HEAVY physical damage to the target and hits every enemy on the path. Applies Stagger.

raceCultSermon.desc: Gather round. Allies within 2 tiles are Blessed for 2 rounds. They have heard the word.

raceAbsolution.desc: Restores a MEDIUM amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses every debuff.

racePrayer.desc: Shields a Single Ally for 200 HP and Blesses them for 2 rounds.

raceDeathPact.desc: Sign here. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages. Costs 25% of max HP (never fatal).

sharedSummonBloodRain.desc: Summons Blood Rain for 3 to 5 rounds. Everyone in the downpour is soaked; Divine units are burned each turn, Unholy units heal HP and MP.

raceReassemble.desc: The bones come apart and put themselves back together somewhere else. Teleports up to 3 tiles and restores 20% of max HP.

raceTentacleLash.desc: An arm from below the surface. Deals WEAK water damage to a Single Enemy and drags them 2 tiles toward you.

raceNaughtyList.desc: You know what you did. The target is on the list: Marked for 3 rounds and its ATK drops by 1 stage.

raceSystemAnalysis.desc: Every port open, every weakness listed. Marks a Single Enemy for 2 rounds and lowers its M DEF by 1 stage.

raceBlueScreen.desc: Fatal exception. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Stuns them for a round.

raceTinFoilHat.desc: Hats on, everybody. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 M DEF stage.

sharedNebula.desc: Birth a star and let it burn. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3; everything the starfire touches keeps burning.

raceFanTheHammer.desc: Six shots from the hip. Deals WEAK physical damage to every enemy next to you.

raceDreadAura.desc: Everything nearby feels it watching. All enemies within 2 tiles are Discorded for 2 rounds.

raceDepthCharge.desc: It goes off under the surface. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a 3×3. Anything soaked takes the shock through its body: bonus damage to Soaked targets.

raceBlackBudget.desc: Money that was never appropriated. Overclocks a Single Ally for 2 rounds: +1 ATK stage and +1 MOV (tech units also +1 RNG).

raceBrainwash.desc: Everyone has something, and we have it. A Single Enemy within 3 tiles takes its next activation under your orders. Bosses cannot be brainwashed.

raceDemonicClaw.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets under a Contract or Soul Bound.

raceBodyCheck.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and shoves them 2 tiles. Applies Stagger.

raceDarkJustice.desc: Charges in and deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Bonus damage to the Wounded or the Silenced.

ironGrip.desc: The grab that also hurts. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and Roots them for 2 rounds. Knocks flying targets out of the sky.

raceBrutalSlam.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster and leaves them Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

raceNoMercy.desc: Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy. Executes a target below 25% HP outright. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

raceDragonfear.desc: Ancient terror, roared down from above. Every enemy in a 3×3 is Feared and set alight. They run, and they run burning.

raceDragonToss.desc: Grabs the target, carries it skyward and hurls it up to 3 tiles. The grab itself is light; the fall and any crash into another unit do the damage. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

raceSleepParalysis.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy. It cannot move or act: Stunned for a round.

raceTransform.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

raceNitroBoost.desc: Floor it. The caster is Overclocked for 2 rounds (+1 ATK stage, +1 MOV) and gains +1 SPD stage.

raceMissileBarrage.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

raceHypnoticPulse.desc: Everything that looks back stops. Every enemy in a 3×3 is Stunned for a round.

raceAbyssalWings.desc: Spread the black wings. Fly up to 4 tiles and land under Protect for a round.

raceNinefoldScratch.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

fire1.desc: A fist of fire. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy; the target keeps burning.

raceAudible.desc: Check with me. Every ally within 2 tiles is Overclocked for a round: +1 ATK stage and +1 MOV (tech allies also +1 RNG).

raceSpiritChannel.name: Séance
raceSpiritChannel.desc: Call on the departed. Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

raceFractalNeedle.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to one enemy; the needle splits and seeks up to two more within 2 tiles for half. Bonus damage to Stunned targets.

raceStasisBeam.desc: Held in the light. Held. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Stuns them for a round. Knocks flying targets out of the sky.

raceNordicAccord.desc: The accord is signed. Every ally on the field gains +1 M ATK and +1 M DEF stage.

gearSignalFlare.desc: One use: thrown up to 8 tiles into the fog, it reveals a diamond 6 tiles out from where it lands. The flare is spent.

raceTitanStep.desc: Fee. Fi. Fo. Fum. Every enemy within 2 tiles is Marked for 2 rounds and Staggered. He knows where you are, and the floor knows it too.

raceApeFury.name: Go Ape
raceApeFury.desc: Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages. Costs 10% of max HP (never fatal).

doubleShot.desc: Two barrels, no waiting. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy across 2 hits.

crossfire.desc: Two shooters' worth of lead on one crossing. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to every enemy on the X around the target.

deadEye.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and Marks them for 3 rounds: the next hit on them lands 60 harder.

raceRapture.desc: The ally is lifted: Protect for a round and Levitating for 2 (flight and the high-ground bonus).

raceWingsOfMercy.desc: Swap places with an ally within 4 tiles.

raceLabyrinthRoar.desc: The walls throw the bellow back from every direction. Every enemy within 2 tiles is Discorded and Taunted: they lose their heads and come for the horns.

raceUnderdogSpirit.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

camouflage.desc: Go still in the brush. Invisible for a round, and the next shot comes from ambush: +1 ATK stage.

raceInfernalConscription.desc: Report for duty. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy, drags them 3 tiles toward the caster and Staggers them.

raceVenomFang.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and Poisons them. A second bite on an envenomed target finds the vein.

raceTunnelNetwork.desc: Dig a tunnel: one mouth beside you, one where you point (within 4). An ally standing at either mouth attacks and casts as if it stood at the other. One tunnel per caster; three hits collapse both mouths.

raceSwarmSignal.desc: The signal goes out. Raises ATK by 2 stages for every ally within 2 tiles.

raceJellySting.desc: A tentacle brushes past. Deals WEAK water damage and Poisons the target. The venom runs faster through soaked skin: bonus damage to Soaked targets.

raceOathOfValor.desc: Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK and +1 DEF stage.

raceCrusade.desc: Deus vult. Deals HEAVY physical damage to All Enemies in an X around the knight, and bonus damage to Unholy targets.

raceSmite.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, and bonus damage to Unholy targets.

thunderstorm.desc: Summons a thunderstorm for 3 to 4 rounds. It hunts the nearest unit, soaks everyone under it and strikes with lightning (deadly to the wet). −5 DEF in the eye.

thunder1.desc: One bolt, one target. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Soaked targets take half again.

raceDarkFeather.desc: One black feather falls. Then he is already there. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and Staggers them.

racePlotArmor.desc: The hero cannot die yet. The next killing blow leaves the caster at 1 HP instead.

raceProphecyFulfilled.desc: It was written. Everything written before it is struck out. The caster is Overclocked for 2 rounds and cleansed of every debuff.

raceQuickDraw.desc: Shoulder the long rifle. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy up to 5 tiles away.

raceEject.desc: Punch out. The pilot escapes up to 3 tiles, sheds every debuff and the frame restores 20% of max HP.

cleanse.name: Inner Peace
cleanse.desc: Removes every debuff from a Single Ally and raises their M DEF by 1 stage.

raceIronBulwark.desc: Shields up. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 DEF and +1 M DEF stage.

raceArtilleryStrike.desc: Fire mission, danger close. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to every enemy in a 3×3 up to 6 tiles away, over any cover. Leaves scorched ground and a crater.

shieldBash.desc: Iron Dome up. Every ally within 2 tiles gets a 160-point shield.

raceHerbalRemedy.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

raceTreelineRetreat.name: Into the Green
raceTreelineRetreat.desc: Step back into the undergrowth. Teleport up to 3 tiles and Regen for 2 rounds.

raceMitosisSplit.desc: Two of it now. Containment will want to know. Splits off a Blob that fights beside you.

racePoliceCuffs.desc: Hands behind your back. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to an adjacent enemy, Roots them for 2 rounds and Staggers them.

racePoliceLockdown.desc: Nobody in, nobody out. Deals HEAVY physical damage to every enemy in a 3×3 within 3 tiles; they are Rooted for a round and Slowed for 2.

raceExecutiveOrder.desc: Signed, sealed, effective immediately. Every enemy in a 3×3 within 4 tiles is Stunned for a round.

sharedNuke.name: Nuclear Option
sharedNuke.desc: The football is open. Mark the grid; two rounds later there is no grid. SEVERE magic damage to everything in a 5×5, buildings included.

raceColdSpot.desc: Opens a cold spot over a 3×3 for 2 rounds. Enemies inside are Frozen.

raceAyahuascaRetreat.desc: The caster restores 50% of max HP, cleanses every debuff and raises M DEF by 1 stage.

racePsychicBarrier.desc: Shields a Single Ally for 200 HP.

psychosis.desc: Two voices, then four, then all of them. A Single Enemy is Discorded for 2 rounds and its M DEF drops by 1 stage.

teleport.desc: Warp any unit (self, ally or enemy) to any unoccupied tile within range. Third Eye trims its cost.

mindShatter.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and Silences them. Deals bonus damage to Silenced targets.

raceTaserBolt.desc: Two prongs into the housing. Systems stutter. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy and Jams it for a round.

raceBigKick.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and kicks them 2 tiles back.

raceSoulSuck.desc: Kiss them and take what they came with. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and heals the caster for half. Deals bonus damage to Charmed targets.

raceShadowInfiltration.desc: Dashes in and deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy.

warCry.name: Anthem
warCry.desc: Every ally within 3 tiles sings along: +2 ATK stages. The singer takes +1.

lullaby.desc: Hush. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy and it sleeps through its next activation (Stun).

knifeThrow.desc: A knife from the sleeve. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy within 4 and Marks them: the next physical hit any ally lands deals +24.

racePopSpotlight.desc: The team's focus-fire call. Lowers a Single Enemy's DEF and M DEF by 1 stage and Marks them for 2 rounds.

raceSpaceDisco.name: Crowd Surge
raceSpaceDisco.desc: The crowd rushes the stage, and the stage is you. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, drags them 1 tile toward the caster and Staggers them.

crossSlash.desc: The X-cut that will not close. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves it Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

raceSymbioticDrain.desc: The tendrils drink from the wound. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and heals the caster for part of it. Deals bonus damage to Poisoned targets.

jackOfAll.desc: Pep talk. A Single Ally gains +1 ATK, DEF, M ATK and M DEF, +1 MOV and +1 RNG for 3 turns.

raceJudgmentBeam.desc: The Watcher decides how long a second lasts. Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in a line and Slows them.

raceTimeRewind.name: Paradox
raceTimeRewind.desc: You were never standing there. Deals SEVERE magic damage to a Single Enemy, then replays the last blow it dealt against it. Deals bonus damage to Slowed or Staggered targets.

passiveCrescendo.desc: Buffs this unit applies last +1 turn.

raceLucidTrap.name: Spring Snare
raceLucidTrap.desc: Clockwork jaws under the leaves. Hides a snare on a tile; the first enemy to step on it is Stunned for a round.

raceBorrowedClaw.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and tears one spell out of them: the skinwalker keeps it, they lose it for the match. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

raceLifetap.desc: Open the vein. The wound will not close. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy, heals the caster for part of it and leaves the target Grievously Wounded.

raceTidalBlessing.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses a debuff.

raceCallOfTheDeep.desc: Something answers from below. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, and the floor under them opens into deep water. Silenced targets cannot call for help: bonus damage.

raceHowl.desc: The pack answers. Every ally within 2 tiles gains +1 ATK stage.

raceCurseOfMisfortune.desc: It runs in the family. Every enemy in a 3×3 is Hexed for 3 rounds.
